text.tspan: Sum of the three parts equals the work to 0.00 %
d/dt (Kₗ + E_σ) = (p_b − p∞) V̇_b − 16πμRṘ². Focusing can move energy between Kₗ and E_σ but cannot create any.
Viscosity μ = 10 mPa·s is chosen only to make the dissipation visible.
Energy ledger from the Rayleigh–Plesset solution of Eq. C1-E07 using the balance of Eq. C1-E11.
